'''Ceoloe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], worked at a [[Blasted Asteroid (the Wheel)|cantina]] in the [[Blasted Asteroid]] commercial chain on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. He was the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] best [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] and [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], being able to handle bar-fights due to his large and muscled physique. Ceoloe was often talkative and obsequious with his customers, but would purposefully make revealing comments loudly while talking to alert [[Waroon Dak]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]], to potential sources of information. Dak paid Ceoloe a finder's fee for these tips as well as for the use of a table near the bar where he plied his trade. The bartender also kept a close [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on the infochant, and would pull him to safety in any bar-fight or if his clients caused him trouble.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ceoloe appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. He was included as someone that players could potentially interact with while searching for information on the Wheel.<ref name="BTR" />
